# Make popup history witness exercise verified free movement

## Context

Parent #17844 requires every failing Neural Link journey to have a truthful disposition or a linked repair. Its [native pair](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17844#issuecomment-6074119217) now identifies a test-fixture defect in the popup-history arm of `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL.spec.mjs` at Engine `d75cc68543` / external Brain `03da5025`.

## The Problem

The arm expects `native-popup-move` after an arbitrary `+120,+90` CDP offset. With a native viewport, that move admitted a native-docking candidate in all 32 polling observations and the unchanged 30s free-move assertion failed. A verified move outside the live target rectangles passed in 11.2s: no docking candidate, stable popup binding/generation, exactly one additional free-move row, correct committed offsets and complete ordered undo/redo. The emulated viewport also reported the popup's own dimensions as its available screen, making it unsuitable for native display placement.

## The Architectural Reality

`src/dashboard/dock/window/Placement.mjs#ingest` intentionally refuses a free-move history row while `DragCoordinator.nativeWindowDropCandidates` contains the source. The existing `DockPlacementNL.spec.mjs` uses a native viewport and observed physical geometry for this evidence class. The failing arm owns selection of the physical scenario; the production writer already passes the verified free-move control.

Design authority: the owning Placement JSDoc says, "A free popup move appends after quiescence." Native-docking suppression remains unchanged. This correction restores the test's stated free-movement scenario and preserves Group history behavior.

## The Fix

Keep the change in the existing Workstation topology test module. Give only this history arm a native viewport, choose physical placement outside the live docking targets with room for a second move, and verify the scenario before demanding a free-move row. Compare the exact new row and committed relative offsets, preserve binding/generation and retain the existing newest-first undo/full-redo checks. Other topology tests retain their established emulated viewport.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Only the popup-history arm uses the native viewport; other topology tests keep their existing fixture.
- [ ] The full popup and its measured move fit the observed native display outside every live target hitbox.
- [ ] Observed physical movement, no native-drop candidate, stable binding/generation, exactly one new `native-popup-move` row and matching committed offsets are asserted.
- [ ] Existing ordered undo/redo assertions remain and the corrected headed arm passes.
- [ ] The historical original-offset red control and current green evidence are linked on the PR and parent; the frozen parent census is not rewritten.

## Out of Scope

Production placement/docking/history changes; other popup conversion mechanisms; native media/film acceptance; wider parent closure; runtime configuration or shared services.

## Avoided Traps

No timeout widening, candidate clearing, manual geometry publication, synthetic transaction row, or count-only false green. No global viewport change that alters unrelated topology tests.

## Decision Record impact

None: test-fixture correction preserving ADR 0029's existing semantic/presentation boundaries. No new `.mjs` module or runtime surface.

## Related

Parent: #17844. The open #16358 owns a separate intermittent large-over-small conversion/park mechanism and is not this fixture correction.
